OnePlus Nord.example:

Hey I recently purchased the edge 60 fusion and so far its working great considering the fact that I'm not a hardcore user I only use it for casual photography and calls mostly.
 Must say I've encountered a few bugs here and there in the UI itself.
 Cameras are great for the price, great details in the photos. Night shots are okayish. 
Battery capacity is less than its competitors being the Vivo T4 and the newly launched Oneplus Nord ce5 but so far as per my use case the battery backup is pretty good. Overall for the price its a good phone.
You can checkout the reviews of the Oneplus Nord ce5 or the Vivo T4 too if you want to consider other brands than Moto
